appDescription: Listen to English news and practise speaking about the same story with Drive English.

function.name: DRIVE_ENGLISH_PLAYBACK
function.description: Control English news listening, change the current article format, or choose listening-only interaction for today.

command.description: The explicit listening action requested by the user.

articleTitle.description: The exact title of the article requested by the user, when specified.

function.name: DRIVE_ENGLISH_ARTICLE_QUESTION
function.description: Ask a question about the current or explicitly named news article, using the stored source as evidence.

questionText.description: The question asked by the user. Preserve the language used.

articleTitle.description: The exact title of the article requested by the user, when specified.

function.name: DRIVE_ENGLISH_PRACTICE
function.description: Start or continue English speaking practice about a news article, submit an answer, request help, retry, or finish.

command.description: The explicit speaking practice action requested by the user.

utteranceText.description: The answer supplied by the user. This parameter alone does not verify original speech language or literal fidelity.

articleTitle.description: The exact title of the article requested by the user, when specified.
